nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint) playerKey accumulating per-address key values used for winner selection.
Public mapping(address=>uint) playerCount tracking number of bets in the current game.
Public mapping(address=>uint) currentGame holding the current round identifier.
Public mapping(address=>uint) currentPlayersRequired, set to 100 at deployment.
Private mapping(address=>uint) playerRegistrationStatus marking which game a player already joined.
Private mapping(address=>uint) playerNumber storing the seat number of each player.
Private mapping(uint=>address) numberToAddress resolving a seat number to a player address.
Public uint currentBet, the exact wei amount required per bet.
Public address contractAddress used as the global mapping key for this contract.
Public address owner with privileged rights via onlyOwner.
Public address lastWinner storing the most recent payout recipient.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner; transfers ownership after zero-address check.
changeBet(uint _newBet) public noPendingBets onlyOwner; updates the required bet amount.
Constructor AllForOne() initializing contract address, round, required players, owner, bet and last winner.
canBet() view returning registration status, current player count and last winner.
placeBet(uint _input) payable betCondition; registers a player, accumulates keys and settles the round when 100 players are reached.
Modifier onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == owner.
Modifier noPendingBets requiring playerCount[contractAddress] == 0.
Modifier betCondition(uint _input) validating registration, player count, msg.value and input positivity.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller address used for authorization and registration.
block.timestamp (now), miner-influenceable value used in the key and winner randomness.
_winningAddress.transfer(currentBet * 99) external value transfer to a participant-derived address.
owner.transfer(currentBet * 1) external value transfer to the owner address.
uint(keccak256(_input + now)) / now, weak randomness plus division arithmetic deriving _playerKey.
uint(keccak256(now + playerKey[contractAddress])) % 100 + 1, weak randomness plus modulo arithmetic deriving the winning number.
playerKey[contractAddress] += _playerKey unchecked uint addition (arithmetic).
playerCount[contractAddress]++ / currentGame[contractAddress]++ unchecked counter increments (arithmetic).
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter _newBet of changeBet.
Parameter _input of placeBet, mixed with block.timestamp for key generation.
Local uint _status returned by canBet.
Local uint _playerCount returned by canBet.
Local address _lastWinner returned by canBet.
Local uint _playerKey computed from _input and now inside placeBet.
Local uint _winningNumber computed from now and accumulated playerKey.
Local address _winningAddress resolved from numberToAddress and paid out.

edges.reason: _input is consumed by placeBet to compute the player key.
_input flows into keccak256(_input + now) key derivation.
msg.sender indexes playerNumber/playerCount/registration in placeBet.
msg.sender is checked against owner inside the onlyOwner guarded transferOwnership.
msg.sender is checked against owner inside the onlyOwner guarded changeBet.
msg.sender reads playerRegistrationStatus in the view canBet.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing privilege.
block.timestamp feeds keccak256(_input + now) / now, creating timestamp dependence for authorization-like key generation.
block.timestamp feeds the winner selection keccak256(now + playerKey[...]).
Key derivation operation produces the local _playerKey.
_playerKey accumulates into playerKey used by the winner derivation.
Winner derivation sets the local _winningNumber.
_winningNumber indexes numberToAddress to obtain _winningAddress.
numberToAddress[_winningNumber] is assigned to _winningAddress.
_winningAddress is the recipient of the 99% payout transfer.
Owner payout is executed in the same settlement branch as the winner payout.
currentBet * 99 is computed for the winner transfer, unchecked multiplication.
currentBet * 1 is computed for the owner transfer.
_newBet parameter is consumed by changeBet.
_newBet is written into currentBet.
changeBet overwrites the currentBet state variable.
newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
newOwner is written into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged owner variable.
Constructor sets contractAddress = this.
Constructor initializes owner.
Constructor sets currentBet to .005 ether.
Constructor initializes lastWinner with msg.sender.
Constructor increments currentGame[contractAddress].
Constructor sets currentPlayersRequired to 100.
canBet reads playerCount[contractAddress].
canBet reads currentGame[contractAddress].
canBet reads playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender].
canBet reads lastWinner.
Local _status is produced and returned by canBet.
Local _playerCount is produced and returned by canBet.
Local _lastWinner is produced and returned by canBet.
betCondition requires playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] < currentGame[contractAddress].
betCondition requires playerCount[contractAddress] < 100.
noPendingBets requires playerCount[contractAddress] == 0.
placeBet writes the player seat into playerNumber[msg.sender].
placeBet increments playerCount[contractAddress].
placeBet stamps playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] with the current game.
placeBet increments currentGame[contractAddress] when the round completes.
placeBet writes numberToAddress[playerNumber[msg.sender]] = msg.sender.
placeBet sets lastWinner = _winningAddress at settlement.
placeBet performs playerKey[contractAddress] += _playerKey.
Round settlement inside placeBet invokes the 99% transfer to the winning address before state is fully finalized.
The owner transfer executes inside the same settlement path of placeBet.
External transfer call hands control to a participant-derived address that can re-enter placeBet before playerKey/playerCount reset.
Owner transfer is an external call that could re-enter placeBet before the round state is cleared.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates changeBet.
noPendingBets modifier prevents bet changes while players are queued.
betCondition modifier gates placeBet on registration, count, value and input checks.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner only exists to be assigned to owner inside transferOwnership, so it collapses into that core function.
Parameter _newBet is only used to overwrite currentBet inside changeBet, so it collapses into that core function.
Parameter _input is only consumed by placeBet for key generation, so it collapses into that core function.
Local _status only holds the return value of canBet, so it collapses into that core function.
Local _playerCount only holds the return value of canBet, so it collapses into that core function.
Local _lastWinner only holds the return value of canBet, so it collapses into that core function.
Local _playerKey is directly produced by the keccak256(_input + now) / now unsafe operation and immediately accumulated.
Local _winningNumber is directly produced by the keccak256(now + playerKey) % 100 + 1 unsafe operation.
Local _winningAddress is resolved solely to receive the payout transfer unsafe operation.
